verdict.rationale: Bruno's docs list pre-request and post-response JavaScript with a `bru` API, request chaining and libraries [bruno-docs-31], with script editors at request, folder and collection level [bruno-docs-37, bruno-docs-38]. The CLI's Developer Mode (`--sandbox=developer`) unlocks external npm packages and filesystem access for scripts [bruno-docs-61], and a community feature request shows pre-request scripts in real use [bruno-comm-9]. Missing for 10: in-depth documentation of the `bru` API and variable-passing mechanics for chaining, and independent hands-on corroboration of chaining and data-massaging workflows (Safe Mode, the CLI default, also limits library and filesystem use).
